entities.name: Marinus II
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pope Marinus II was the bishop of Rome and ruler of the Papal States from 30 October 942 to his death. He ruled during the Saeculum obscurum. He was also erroneously called Pope Martin III leading to the second pope named Martin taking the name Martin IV.
